image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a bed of dark, decaying leaf litter. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular yellow-orange markings along its back and head. Its skin appears wet and reflective. The head is visible on the left, showing a broad shape, while the body curves towards the right. The background consists of out-of-focus brown leaves.
